title: The Measure mode hint fits one short line and never covers the legend
goal: Switching Measure modes raises a short pill naming the mode. The Size line runs sixteen words, so its pill is about 500 points wide, stays almost twice as long as the others, and on a narrow window can sit on top of the roles legend. Every hint should be one short line, and the bracket keys it teaches should be taught somewhere that stays, next to the Mode control.
notes: From audit 2026-09-02-measure-mode-hint rough 2, 3 and 4. Code: Sources/PhotonzCore/MeasureModeHint.swift holds the lines and the timing; EditorView.canvasNoticeChip shows the pill bottom-centre above the tool bar and shares its slot with the Copied pill; the legend is placed by CornerPlacement.swift. Inspector Mode picker: Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift around line 656. Flag next-measure-modes; Current keeps its first-run line. DONE: see log. Reservation numbers live in MeasureModeHint.reservedSize and EditorState.measureLegendSize; if the pill's type or padding changes, re-measure with an ImageRenderer script (temp/measure-hint/render-hints.swift pattern) and update reservedSize.
acceptance: In the Next release with next-measure-modes on: press I and cycle modes; every hint reads in one short line (under about 45 characters) and all four pills fade on the same schedule.
The [ and ] tip appears beside the Mode control in the Measure Tool section of the inspector, so it is never lost.
With measurements piled into a top corner on a canvas under 800 points wide, the hint and the legend never overlap, verified by a layout test in PhotonzCore.
Scripts/test.sh green; audit written under queue/audits/ with a render of all four hints; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task.

log.note: Adversarial review before building: the pill is a two-second toast, so it can only ever teach one thing; the [ and ] tip needs a line that stays, and the inspector's Mode field is the one place the mode is already a word. Distance's line must keep saying a THIRD click places the number (the earlier walk found first-timers stuck after two clicks). Per-word lifetime stretch dropped: with every line short, one schedule reads as one family, and a pill that lingers reads as slowness.

Overlap review: a three-row legend in a bottom corner crosses the hint band by 13 pt and, on any canvas narrower than the tool bar plus two legend widths, sits BEHIND the tool bar, which is drawn last. So the fix reserves the bottom chrome (hint slot, whether or not a pill is up, plus the bar's measured width) as hard-blocked corners in CornerPlacement, and measurements stay soft: over a measurement beats behind the bar.

Built: MeasureToolMode.hint four lines of 36 to 43 chars, hintLengthLimit 45, new keyTip (Size only); MeasureModeHint fixed 2 s lifetime and reservedSize 344x34 (widest pill renders 328x31); CornerPlacement.firstClear gains blocked:; EditorChromeLayout.bottomNoticeFrame / toolBarFrame / bottomChrome; EditorState.measureLegendCorner blocks that chrome and learns toolBarWidth from EditorView's preference; LayersPanel shows keyTip under the Mode picker and names the keys in its tooltip.

Verified on the probe app (Next, default flags) with a temporary harness driving the real editor: all four hints raised by I, Size pill left after 1.95 s; at a 435 pt canvas with three legend rows and both top corners under measurements, the old placement chose bottomLeading (crossing both hint and bar) and the new one keeps topLeading; 700, 800, 900, 1000 pt canvases never cross either. Harness removed before commit.

Scripts/test.sh green (1256 tests). One run in between saw the two ElementBounds timing tests trip their 10 ms / 50 ms budgets by about a millisecond while a build ran alongside; they passed in the runs before and after, unrelated to this change.

Renders: queue/audits/2026-09-02-measure-hint-lines-{light,dark}.png (the four pills), -inspector-tip.png (Mode field, Size vs Distance), -narrow.png (real-app layer render of the 435 pt canvas; glass and the inspector panel do not draw offscreen).
